messages:
maria-partners: Heads up — partner AMI images in the marketplace are hitting a performance/regression signal with the CUDA12.2 + ROCm5 combo we rolled yesterday. Partner reported slower token throughput and OOMs on long contexts. Starting a rollback/hotfix plan. :rotating_light:
ken-engineering: Ugh. Do we have a repro trace or a CI failure? Which instance types and kernels affected?
maria-partners: Partner included a small repro run: `nvidia-smi` shows driver 535.XX on some AMIs, and ROCm stack shows rocm-5.4. Attach snippet they sent:
```
GPU 0: 48% util
RAM usage spikes at 22GB
nvml: driver 535.54
rocm-smi: ROCm v5.4
```
They said it reproduces on g5x2 and p4d-ish shapes (mixed hw).
tara-sre: Can we isolate to a specific driver build or a kernel ABI? If it's multi-hw, maybe a kernel ABI drift or a cuDNN/kernels mismatch. We should freeze marketplace images and stop auto-updates for affected SKUs ASAP.
li-devex: Agreed. Marketplace images need a pinned driver tag. Current AMI tags are `redwood-llm-2026-03-cuda12.2` — we need a patch tag like `-no-driver-535` or `-drv-532` fallback. Also cloud marketplaces (AWS, GCP) take ~4-24h to publish changes; we'll need to coordinate partner comms on the window.
alex-ops: Proposed immediate actions:
1) Pause new image rollouts for marketplace SKUs (set promotion flag to false).
2) Build a rollback AMI pinned to driver 532.x and ROCm 5.3 (tag: `redwood-llm-rollback-driver-532`).
3) Run canary on 4 partner-linked instances (g5, a100-ish) for 30m synthetic load.
4) If green, request expedited marketplace replace/promotion and send partner notice.
I can own 1-3 if eng + sRE ok with test matrix.
ken-engineering: I'll repro locally with their steps and try a microbench comparing token/sec and mem footprint. If it's an upstream kernel ABI, we may need a tiny kernel module tweak or to pin libcudnn/cuda toolkit layers.
maria-partners: I'll draft partner-facing comms. Key points: we're rolling image back to pinned driver, ETA for partner-facing patch, what we need from them (e.g., confirm non-prod smoke by X). Draft below — please edit:
"Hi — we've identified a regression affecting specific marketplace images running CUDA12.2+ROCm5 on certain instance types. We're preparing a rollback to a pinned driver version (532.x) and will run canaries. We'll follow up with an expected replace window and validation checklist."
li-devex: Add a link to the KB and the compatibility matrix: <https://redwood.internal/docs/driver-compat-matrix> and add that auto-update is disabled until validation passes.
tara-sre: Testing checklist for canary:
- start 3 replicas per instance type
- perf run with 1k token prompts (same seed)
- memory stress test (long context run)
- check tails for OOM/GPU reset logs
- if any reset, abort and escalate to nvidia/rocm partners
ken-engineering: For the repro I'll log outputs to `/tmp/marketplace-regress/YYYY.log` and attach perf diffs. Also will run `LD_PRELOAD` shim test to see if kernel call mismatch shows up.
deploy-bot: release 2026.03.18-driver-rollback created: artifact id rwd-ami-rollback-532-20260318
alex-ops: Nice — got the artifact. I'll start canary spins in us-west-2 partner-zone. ETA 30m to initial runs.
maria-partners: Partner PM asked about announcement wording. Add this snippet: "No forced auto-updates will be applied to customer instances in the next 48 hours; if you run managed auto-update, we recommend switching to manual until we confirm stability." :thumbsup: \nken-engineering: Quick note — if we discover the reg is due to fused kernels in the 535 driver, rollback minimizes customer impact but we should schedule a follow-up tech deep-dive with NVIDIA/ROCm SAs. I'll prepare logs and a minimal reproducer.
li-devex: Who will update marketplace listing notes (public-facing)? I can prepare the release notes but need final phrasing from legal/comms.
maria-partners: I'll loop in comms/legal in the partner thread after we confirm canary. tagging @li-devex and @alex-ops for the marketplace timeline.
tara-sre: If canary passes, plan for staggered promotion across regions (us-west -> eu -> ap) with a 2h observation window per region.
maria-partners: OK executing this. I'll post updates here. Next update in ~45m or sooner if canary fails. Thanks all.
